name: slag
description: Experimental agentic plugins and tools that are not meant for public consumption.

plugins.name: anneal
plugins.description: Audits how easy an existing repository is for an AI agent to find its way around — map file, toolchain version, names, layout, build output, check commands — then proposes a layout you approve and migrates in small commits, each checked against the project's own tests.

plugins.name: collet
plugins.description: Holds a session inside the task it was given: one open task with the files it may touch and the command that ends it, a guard that refuses writes outside that list, and checks that each ship with a violation and a near miss so none of them counts as coverage before it has been shown to work. A project that already plans its work in a roadmap it does not own is left alone: the mount writes nothing there.
